# xshield_enforcement_receipt (Resource)

Reports to Xshield that an enforcement snapshot has been applied, and which cloud resource was created for each construct in it.

Place it in the same configuration as the rendered resources and reference their IDs, so it is only sent once they all exist. Xshield rejects a receipt whose hash does not match the snapshot, or whose resources omit or add to the snapshot's, so a partial or altered render is never recorded as converged.

A new receipt is sent only when the applied version or a resource ID changes, so it adds nothing to a plan that has nothing else to do. If Xshield's latest receipt for the account and region is no longer this one, the next plan proposes sending it again.

Destroying it removes it from state and leaves the receipt history in Xshield.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Report the applied snapshot and the cloud resource created for each construct
# in it. Referencing the rendered resources means the receipt is only sent once
# they all exist.
resource "xshield_enforcement_receipt" "this" {
  cloud_account_id = data.xshield_enforcement_snapshot.this.cloud_account_id
  region           = data.xshield_enforcement_snapshot.this.region
  workspace        = "ct-enforcement-123456789012-us-east-1"
  snapshot_version = data.xshield_enforcement_snapshot.this.version
  content_hash     = data.xshield_enforcement_snapshot.this.content_hash
  vpc_id           = var.vpc_id

  groups       = { for slug, sg in aws_security_group.group : slug => sg.id }
  markers      = { for slug, sg in aws_security_group.marker : slug => sg.id }
  address_sets = { for slug, pl in aws_ec2_managed_prefix_list.pl : slug => pl.id }
  rules = merge(
    { for key, r in aws_vpc_security_group_ingress_rule.ingress : key => r.security_group_rule_id },
    { for key, r in aws_vpc_security_group_egress_rule.egress : key => r.security_group_rule_id },
  )
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_account_id` (String) Cloud account the snapshot was applied to.
- `content_hash` (String) Content hash of the snapshot that was applied, from `xshield_enforcement_snapshot`.
- `groups` (Map of String) Cloud ID created for each enforcement group, keyed by group slug.
- `region` (String) Region the snapshot was applied to.
- `rules` (Map of String) Rule ID created for each snapshot rule, keyed by the snapshot's rule key.
- `snapshot_version` (Number) Version of the snapshot that was applied, from `xshield_enforcement_snapshot`.
- `vpc_id` (String) Network the enforcement groups were rendered into.
- `workspace` (String) Name of the enforcement workspace that applied it, as shown in Xshield.

### Optional

- `address_sets` (Map of String) Cloud ID created for each address set, keyed by address set slug.
- `markers` (Map of String) Cloud ID created for each marker, keyed by marker slug.

### Read-Only

- `applied_at` (String) When Xshield recorded the receipt.
- `id` (String) Receipt identifier assigned by Xshield.
- `run_id` (String) Run that sent the receipt, taken from `TFC_RUN_ID` when running in HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by account and region. This adopts the receipt Xshield currently holds,
# which recovers a lost state file without sending a new receipt.
terraform import xshield_enforcement_receipt.this "123456789012/us-east-1"
```
